summary: Build analytics adoption, data literacy, and governance skills in 5 days. Turn dashboards into decisions and stronger culture.
lede: Building a data-driven culture means making analytics part of everyday decisions and reporting. For data leaders, analysts, transformation managers, and operations managers, the course covers assessing data maturity and dashboard use, strengthening governance and KPI routines, and creating stakeholder-aligned adoption plans. Participants also examine AI-assisted insight workflows and recurring reporting, including human review of machine-generated summaries, to connect analytical outputs with operational decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who must improve how their organization uses data in day-to-day decisions, reporting, and performance reviews.
audience: Operations Manager using dashboards to drive process
prerequisites: Prerequisites: working knowledge of business reporting, basic KPI interpretation, and familiarity with spreadsheets or BI dashboards such as Microsoft Excel, Power BI, or Tableau. No coding is required for completion, and advanced analytics is covered at an operational awareness level rather than a technical engineering level. Learners should bring a laptop and, where possible, sample organizational reports, dashboard screenshots, or a current KPI pack for practical exercises.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
